messages:
tom-sales: Hey finance — need a quick decision. Customer "Nimbus Health" is threatening to churn unless we issue a one-off credit. They hit 2x expected usage in onboarding due to a config bug; support fixed it. Asking for $50,000 retention credit applied to April invoice. Can we approve? /cc @leah-finance @ida-revops

leah-finance: Can you paste the invoice or invoice id and the org id? need AR entry to process. Also what's the MRR impact and why we can't do a future discount instead?

tom-sales: INV-2025-091 (https://billing.redwood/invoices/INV-2025-091) org: nimbus-health, acct: NH-3378. MRR is $18k. Credit request is $50,000 one-time to cover overages + goodwill. Reason: onboarding bug caused cascade; CS owns remediation but customer wants credit. Agree future discount would be OK but customer wants immediate offset to close the renewal.

ida-revops: Propose alternative: offer 3 months 25% discount + $10k credit? preserves revenue recognition. If they insist on one-time credit, we need VP-Finance approval and GL code. Also legal review for amendment if we change renewal terms.

ara-cs: Adding context from CS call: They threatened to pause production; renewal in 6 weeks. We already committed to a migration assist. If we don't do this they'll move to competitor. Customer is enterprise, referenceable. Support ticket: #45217.

billing-bot: invoice INV-2025-091 balance: $67,214. Payment terms: Net30. Created: 2025-04-02. Link: https://billing.redwood/invoices/INV-2025-091

leah-finance: Ok. Run numbers: if we give $50k credit now, net churn avoided = $216k ARR (estimated). Need journal entry: GL 4800 contra-revenue. Also need written approval from VP-Finance. I'll prepare a memo template — tag me when you have legal OK.

tom-sales: looping in @vp-finance for sign-off. customer is insistent; timeline: decision by EOD today would save renewal.

vp-finance: Quick review — Approved: one-time retention credit $50,000 to be applied as negative invoice against INV-2025-091. Conditions: 1) CS to add clause to renewal amendment that prevents similar credits without exec approval; 2) RevOps to update forecast; 3) Legal to sign amendment. GL code 4800 confirmed. Please proceed.

leah-finance: noted. will process credit and post JE after legal sign-off. tagging @billing-bot to create negative invoice.

billing-bot: Created credit memo CM-2025-067 linked to INV-2025-091 for $50,000. Status: pending legal ack. https://billing.redwood/credits/CM-2025-067

tom-sales: Thanks all :tada: — keeping notes for renewals.
